comparison.objective: Reseat one half-inserted network plug; candidate fractures and recovers four installed HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Plug pushing among neighboring cords versus coaxial mandrel holding, controlled hammering, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Plug depth ≥22 mm without disturbing neighbors versus four contact-driven notch fractures, retained coils, and four contained tangs.
comparison.reason: Insertion is excluded from the candidate and does not test impact fracture or free-fragment recovery.
